description: This file defines a React functional component named CostsGroupedBarChart that renders a responsive grouped bar chart for displaying cost data per agent, grouped by environment or cost category. It includes imports from React, recharts, and internal utility/theme modules, and contains logic for data shaping, theming, and rendering the chart with accessibility features.

methods.name: CostsGroupedBarChart
methods.description: React functional component that renders a grouped bar chart with customizable data, grouping, theming, and accessibility options.
